text:
Emma: Kickoff for VoltLite marketplace onboarding. Scope: AWS/GCP/Azure images, offer metadata, legal blurbs, pricing trial, and a staged preflight. Can PartnerOps confirm what's already in staging?
Theo: I can own manifest + pricing. Proposal: 14-day trial + per-seat metered. We should include a recommended_instance field, not pin families.
PartnerOps: Staging publisher entries created. Vault folder `marketplace/volt-lite-staging`. Uploaded creds + sample artifacts: AWS AMI `ami-0a12b3c4`, GCP image `voltlite-stg-2026-09-10`, Azure VHD `voltlite-stg.vhd`. Links + checksums in the vault.
Sana: Infra asks for exact TF outputs shape so our deploy scripts work. Expected outputs: `publisher_account_id`, `listing_bucket`, `kms_key_arn`, `delegated_admin_role`. Example:
```
publisher_account_id = "901234567890"
listing_bucket = "redwood-marketplace-staging"
kms_key_arn = "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:901234567890:key/abcd12ef"
```
Also need ARM snippet for Azure and a `gcloud compute images create` command for GCP.
Legal: We need EULA (redlines allowed), a DPA summary, export-control statement, and a short privacy/telemetry blurb. Telemetry default: aggregate-only, 30 days retention, opt-out via account settings. No PII.
Emma: Assets required: SVG logo, 1200x600 PNG, three screenshots, a 60s demo video link, short desc <=240 chars, long desc <=1200 chars, marketing contact email. Regions default US/EU/APAC.
Theo: Manifest skeleton I'll post under `marketplace/manifests/voltlite.json`. Include fields: offerId, sku, pricing.trial_days, recommended_instance, assets[]. Will wait for infra/legal to fill.
PartnerOps: I opened pre-warm tickets with AWS and Azure for entitlement mapping. Also requested a publisher window next week for staging publish.
Sana: For security, include KMS policy details in the manifest notes and enable customer-supplied keys option in Dedicated listings.
Legal: Drafting EULA and DPA now. Telemetry blurb: "Aggregated non-PII usage retained 30 days; customers may opt out; no PII collected or transmitted." Will upload by EOD.
InfraBot: Preflight checklist created: images present, manifest shape validated, legal docs linked. Preflight run scheduled for 2026-09-20 09:00 UTC.
Emma: Action list: 1) PartnerOps - confirm final offerId + upload final images + checksums by Fri. 2) Sana - drop TF outputs + ARM/GCP snippets by EOD. 3) Legal - post EULA/DPA + telemetry text by EOD. 4) Theo - publish manifest draft and link here. Dry-run staging publish targeted for Tue.
Theo: I'll publish manifest draft in 1Password now and tag infra/legal for feedback. Snippet: {"offerId":"<tbd>","sku":"voltlite-trial","pricing":{"trial_days":14,"model":"per_seat"},"recommended_instance":"g5.xlarge"} (will update when offerId available)
PartnerOps: Offer metadata proposed: offerId `redwood-voltlite-01`, publisher display `Redwood Inference`, sku `voltlite-trial-v1`. Posted to vault.
Sana: TF outputs and ARM/GCP snippets uploaded to vault. Posting root link here.
Legal: EULA and short DPA uploaded to Drive; pasted telemetry blurb into manifest comments.
InfraBot: Preflight job queued: job id pf-2839001234; checks scheduled 2026-09-20 09:00 UTC.
Emma: Thanks team. If anything blocks the EOD deliverables, ping @Emma. We'll do a preflight dry-run on Tue and sync after. :rocket:
